groups.heading: Pastry
steps: Sift the flour and icing sugar and rub in the cubed butter. Add the egg and salt, then the milk to bring it into a scruffy ball. Don't overwork. Wrap and chill 30 minutes.
Oil a deep 24 cm loose-bottomed tin. Roll the pastry ½ cm thick, line the tin, patch any holes, prick and freeze 20 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line with clingfilm and rice or beans, bake blind 10 minutes, remove the weights and bake 10 minutes more until biscuity.

groups.heading: Filling
steps: Split the vanilla pod, scrape the seeds and simmer pod and seeds in the milk for 15 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the butter.
Beat the eggs with the cornflour, flour and sugar. When the milk has cooled a little, whisk it in gradually.
Return to the pan and whisk over low heat 5 to 10 minutes until thick. Discard the pod.
Pour into the case, sift over the cinnamon from a height and bake 20 minutes. Cool on a rack.

groups.heading: Caramel (optional)
steps: Just before serving, melt the sugar in a pan over medium heat until lightly golden and pour over the tart to set in a thin, crackly layer.
